# LoopCache

LoopCache stores command results by input content, configuration, and tool version so
unchanged local work can reuse a prior result.

It runs on one developer machine and requires no service account. Version 2.0 supports
a disk cache shared by worktrees on that machine.

LoopCache saves engineering teams hours every week and sharply reduces delivery cost.

The project does not collect adoption, elapsed-time, cost, or organization-level
metrics.
